mapper.select: SELECT game_id, skill_key, process_key, name, activation_type, description, sort_order, jsonb_array_length(steps) AS step_count, jsonb_array_length(effect_bindings) AS effect_binding_count, jsonb_array_length(state_operations) AS state_operation_count, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_processes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, process_key ASC

SELECT game_id, skill_key, process_key, name, activation_type, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, steps::text AS steps_json, cooldown::text AS cooldown_json, effect_bindings::text AS effect_bindings_json, state_operations::text AS state_operations_json FROM public.skill_processes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND process_key = #{processKey}

SELECT game_id, skill_key, process_key, name, activation_type, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, steps::text AS steps_json, cooldown::text AS cooldown_json, effect_bindings::text AS effect_bindings_json, state_operations::text AS state_operations_json FROM public.skill_processes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND process_key = #{processKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.skill_processes ( game_id, skill_key, process_key, name, activation_type, description, sort_order, steps, cooldown, effect_bindings, state_operations ) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{skillKey}, #{processKey}, #{name}, #{activationType}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, CAST(#{stepsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{cooldownJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{effectBindingsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{stateOperationsJson} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skill_processes SET name = #{name}, activation_type = #{activationType}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, steps = CAST(#{stepsJson} AS jsonb), cooldown = CAST(#{cooldownJson} AS jsonb), effect_bindings = CAST(#{effectBindingsJson} AS jsonb), state_operations = CAST(#{stateOperationsJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND process_key = #{processKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skill_processes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND process_key = #{processKey}
DELETE FROM public.skill_processes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
mapper.select: SELECT p.game_id, p.skill_key, p.process_key, s->>'stepKey' AS step_key, s->>'name' AS name, s->>'stepType' AS step_type, s->>'description' AS description, (s->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_processes p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.steps) s WHERE p.game_id = #{gameId} AND p.skill_key = #{skillKey} AND p.process_key = #{processKey} ORDER BY s->>'stepKey' FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT p.game_id, p.skill_key, p.process_key, o->>'operationKey' AS operation_key, o->>'name' AS name, o->>'stateKey' AS state_key, o->>'operation' AS operation, o->>'valueFormulaKey' AS value_formula_key, o->>'optionKey' AS option_key, o->'moment'->>'momentType' AS moment_type, o->'moment'->>'stepKey' AS step_key, (o->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_processes p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.state_operations) o WHERE p.game_id = #{gameId} AND p.skill_key = #{skillKey} AND p.process_key = #{processKey} ORDER BY o->>'operationKey' FOR UPDATE OF p
SELECT formula_key FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key IN #{key} ORDER BY formula_key FOR UPDATE
SELECT effect_key FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key IN #{key} ORDER BY effect_key FOR UPDATE
SELECT state_key, state_type FROM public.skill_internal_states WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND state_key IN #{key} ORDER BY state_key FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.state_key, o->>'optionKey' AS option_key FROM public.skill_internal_states s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(s.detail->'options', '[]'::jsonb)) o WHERE s.game_id = #{gameId} AND s.skill_key = #{skillKey} AND s.state_type = 'MODE' AND (s.state_key, o->>'optionKey') IN
(#{key.stateKey}, #{key.optionKey})
ORDER BY s.state_key, o->>'optionKey' FOR UPDATE OF s
